topic: DSA CP hidden AllGather/local Q overlap
mechanism: Start Q from local hidden while TP AllGather of the complete hidden runs; wait before WKV consumes gathered data.
environment: Historical 8x910B3, DP2xTP4/EP8, DSpark7, prefill 2024x4096 to 8096x4096 BF16; exact 32K short c1, max8.
observed: Historical KEEP: median TTFT 4.165268 to 4.106105s, -59.163ms (-1.420%), three paired prompts positive. Trace 157.360ms AG overlap did not all reach service wall.
failure_or_limit: No formal 48x32K->1024 result; trace overlap is not an E2E saving. HCCL/AIV/Q contention or other path limits were suggested, not individually measured.
revalidate_when: Decode TP8 shape 12x4096 to 96x4096, graph capture, current Runtime ownership and full-cycle critical path differ; require same-state parity, matched downstream endpoint, repeated formal E2E.
extreme_relation: Loop065 H003 is the new decode analogue; Run292/293 show local overlap and an earlier next AllToAll, but not a complete Target or Product gain.

topic: DSA CP Compressor cross-stream resource contention
mechanism: Move real Compressor onto auxiliary stream concurrent with WKV/indexer Cube or local Q tail; preserve final join.
environment: Historical DP2xTP4 prefill: Compressor c4/c128 actual native shape and W4A8 chain or 2024-row Q tail; event-timed matched microbench.
observed: R21 WKV overlap added about 0.18-0.23ms/call and 7.29-8.12ms/chunk; R28 Q-tail overlap regressed 9.60-10.39% c4 and 22.52-23.00% c128. Outputs bit-exact.
failure_or_limit: The tested schedules had resource and event overhead; local overlap windows did not reduce critical path. This rejects those implementations under old shapes, not all CP scheduling.
revalidate_when: Only if TP8 decode node sizes, native workspace, occupancy or dependency windows differ enough; compare common predecessor, consumer, collective arrival, full Target tail and Product E2E.
extreme_relation: Loop064 CP fork and Loop065 H003 must account for competing AIC/AIV/HBM/HCCL use; earlier launch alone is not a saving.

topic: Indexer shared-storage state and scatter parity method
mechanism: Validate only actual valid Compressor rows and physically addressed state/cache blocks; preserve typed alias when testing dual scatter.
environment: Historical DP2xTP4; R18 real TH Compressor with block/row validation, R33 isolated A2 key/scale scatter proxy.
observed: R18 showed valid-row and addressed-state validation method. R33 optimistic two-to-one scatter proxy saved at most 0.0404225ms/layer; its test allocated separate dense key/scale tensors.
failure_or_limit: R33 fixture did not preserve current 4160B shared page alias of FP32 state, INT8 key and FP16 scale, and cannot prove owner-compact lifetime safety. Historical REVERT was an implementation-scope decision.
revalidate_when: For owner16, compare exact physical touched byte ranges including key/scale and prefix alias; then QLI/Sparse and cross-cycle consumers. Do not compare unused/padded rows as semantics.
extreme_relation: Run294 owner16 Compressor valid output is exact on 8/8 ranks; whole-owner-state-page bytes differ on ranks0-6, so no current KEEP or compulsory-traffic deletion.

mechanism: Delay wait for Target layer2 hidden AllGather until gathered WKV consumer while local Q proceeds.
environment: Current frozen DP1xTP8 DSpark7 Target layer2 decode, 12x4096 local and 96x4096 gathered BF16; matched profiler A1/B, five exact cohorts each.
observed: 16/16 rank-cycle windows have real overlap, median 13.75us. Matched B-A1 next AllToAll completion -10.125us, 16/16 earlier.
failure_or_limit: Complete Target tail faster only 8/16 and next Target interval only 4/8; acceptance/routes differ. Profiler TPS is diagnostic. Same-prestate typed parity and repeated formal E2E pending.
revalidate_when: If the schedule is promoted beyond one layer, first establish A0 and same-prestate parity, then exposed cycle gain and formal repeats; revisit if resource architecture changes.
extreme_relation: Current scheduling-aware local candidate, not a numeric bound or KEEP.

mechanism: Run native c4 indexer Compressor on two complete owner requests (16 rows) instead of all twelve replicated requests (96 rows), with complete private shared storage.
environment: Current frozen DP1xTP8 eager diagnostic Target layer2, global96/local12, one real cohort; four independent private alias-preserving shared state/key/scale backings from identical prestate.
observed: Run294/295: all8 owner four valid Compressor slots bit exact; broad historical page gate failed because A-only nonowner writes alias older owner table pages. Run296: all8 owner current write and conservative live8 read state bytes exact before/after original rotate and typed key/scale scatter; owner slots exact; fixed-real-query native QLI topk [12,1,512] exact across A/A2/B/A3. Carrier bench12 and all8 Runtime pass. Run297 paired private eager native chain: all8 parity pass, but B−full update rank-median +0.00303 ms and through-QLI +0.00016 ms; only 9/40 pairs B faster than both A controls, below A/A2 drift. Run298 private Graph A96/B16/A2 semantic gate pass all8; pooled B−full replay median −0.005645 ms, but 40/80 strict both-control wins and 0.008240 ms A/A2 drift, so local gain unresolved.
failure_or_limit: Run296 closes only one real layer2 same-prestate indexer consumer. Conservative read envelope is a gate, not a native address census. Sparse, SWA/main Compressor, cross-cycle ownership, parking/prefix, FULL Graph, actual removed traffic, exposed cycle time and formal Product E2E are untested. Eager event span includes possible Host submission gaps; current native owner16 has no demonstrated throughput gain. One-layer private Graph lacks downstream rank rendezvous, full Target resource competition and persistent cross-layer cache lifetime.
revalidate_when: Reuse owner16 if whole DSA producer ownership and liveness closure yields a larger critical-path opportunity, or if Graph implementation/shape changes; do not repeat local small-shape timing as current top priority.
extreme_relation: Correctness-proven local method, small unstable private Graph performance signal; no Product gain. Pivot toward whole producer alias/consumer closure.

topic: QLI same-input topk parity and performance transfer
mechanism: Compare native QuantLightningIndexer variants using identical query, paged key, scales, metadata and valid topk output; separate correctness from local latency and product wall.
environment: Historical DP2xTP4/EP8 prefill, 2024x64x128 INT8 query, paged key31060x32x1x128, topk1024, four compressed-key lengths; paired microbench only.
observed: R19 v2 topk indices were exact in 8/8 real-shape comparisons, but paired latency direction was unstable and best-round four-chunk period bound was only +0.240%; historical REVERT without service E2E.
failure_or_limit: Old operator version and prefill shape do not predict current TP8 decode QLI cost. Exact topk is a useful consumer parity method, not proof of owner state lifetime or Product gain.
revalidate_when: Run296 has now verified current layer2 fixed-query native QLI topk exact for private full96/owner16 caches at all8 ranks; measure current downstream cost before any product intervention, and recheck on other shapes or cache lifetimes.
extreme_relation: Method prior for owner typed scatter→QLI gate; no historical verdict transfer.

topic: Extreme whole DSA producer ownership and shared backing
mechanism: All three Target DSA cache producers (WKV/SWA, indexer, main Compressor) consume gathered full hidden while local attention queries only two adjacent owner requests per rank. Explore reducing producer work and eventually full hidden gather to local12 plus four-row partner halo, subject to byte-level cross-layer cache liveness.
environment: Frozen DP1xTP8 c12 real Target c4 layer2; Run287 40 rank-cohort original FULL Graph ownership observations plus current private indexer diagnostics.
observed: Owner geometry is 16 complete request rows/rank from global96 and local12. Full hidden feeds three producer branches in current dsa_cp.py. Run287 layer2-related views occupy three unique backing stores totaling 2,375,936,640 B/rank, layout stable 40/40; two 1.117GB backings alias neighboring layers. Indexer owner16 immediate QLI parity passes, but private Graph local benefit is small and below control drift.
failure_or_limit: No full typed Target/Draft view registry or byte-level last-writer/read closure; same storage or whole-page alias alone is not a semantic conflict. No SWA/main Compressor/Sparse or cross-cycle/private state parity and no measured halo communication/Product gain. A four-bank clone would exceed 9GB/rank before other memory; avoid blind cloning.
revalidate_when: Run299 graph-outside read-only typed view/byte interval provenance census across adjacent cycles and first parking, then private full-producer→Sparse consumer gate only if conflicts are narrowed; halo exchange after all consumer/lifetime gates.
extreme_relation: Architectural Scheduling/Resource hypothesis with potentially wider exposed path than isolated indexer owner16; unproven, no TPS bound.
